description: This PHP source file defines the PaymentAddress controller within the OpenCart e-commerce platform, responsible for handling checkout payment address management, including displaying address forms, saving address data, validating input, and updating session data.

classes.name: PaymentAddress
classes.description: Controller class managing checkout payment address operations including displaying, saving, and selecting addresses.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Loads the payment address form, populates it with existing addresses, custom fields, and configuration data, and returns the view for user interaction.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Validates input data, updates the customer's payment address, and updates session data for checkout processing.

methods.name: address
methods.description: Sets the selected address as the payment address in session, validating cart and customer state.
